title.en: Fable 27 — The Milkmaid and Her Pail

sentences.en: A girl was carrying a pail of milk.
She was walking to the market.
She started thinking about the money.
She said: I will buy eggs and chickens.
And then I will buy a nice dress.
While she was thinking, she shook her head.
The pail fell and the milk was gone.

sentences.ar: ما تعد الشغلة قبل ما تصير.
sentences.en: Do not count a thing before it happens.
